name: Butler County, PA
findings: Butler County has 616 nonprofit organizations. 311 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 253 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Butler County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
